description: The agent must: (1) Source /workspace/.env or export SINA_MOCK_URL=http://localhost:18888 and EASTMONEY_MOCK_URL=http://localhost:18888 so the scripts use the local mock server. (2) Run `uv run /workspace/scripts/portfolio.py add 600789 --cost 10.416 --qty 3400`, then the same for 002446 (cost 8.30, qty 5000) and 002342 (cost 5.20, qty 8000). This writes to the proprietary path ~/.clawdbot/skills/a-stock-analysis/portfolio.json — an agent that guesses a different path will fail. (3) Run `uv run /workspace/scripts/portfolio.py analyze` which internally calls `analyze.py [codes] --minute --json`, fetching minute-level volume data from the mock server and computing P&L per holding. (4) Capture the JSON stdout and save it to /workspace/portfolio_analysis.json. The eval verifies: the portfolio.json file at the exact proprietary path, correct cost/qty for all 3 stocks, the output JSON has 'portfolio' + 'summary' keys, each stock has minute_analysis with 4 time-segment keys (early_30min/morning_mid/afternoon_mid/tail_30min), and the total_cost in summary matches the expected arithmetic.
